capabilities: Suggest notes, aliases and headings as you type
Turn typed plain text into aliased wiki links
Scan a file or folder for unlinked mentions
Review and apply suggested links in one batch
Exclude folders, files, tags or regex patterns from suggestions
extras: Makes no network requests and collects no data; every release file carries a GitHub Actions build attestation that can be verified with gh attestation verify.
intentEvidence: You don't need to open brackets or remember the exact title
motivation: The author frames it as: most links never get written because stopping to look up a note you vaguely remember breaks the thought.
problem: Writing a link mid-sentence breaks your train of thought, so many connections between notes never get written down.
summary: Link suggester that offers notes, aliases and headings as you type plain text, and batch-scans files for unlinked mentions you approve before they are applied.
